operations.title: Every supported four-site node has a mixed-Tate marked arrangement
operations.body: The 196 supported node occurrences reduce to eight exact local hyperplane-matroid signatures, of ranks two or three and OS Betti vectors (1,2,1), (1,3,3,1), or (1,4,6,3). All are rational hyperplane arrangements and therefore mixed Tate.

operations.title: Exact local marked-node matroid census
operations.body: The checker linearizes every vanishing source denominator at every supported node, retains occurrence depth, deduplicates only geometric normals, constructs intersection lattices, and computes the eight-signature OS census.

operations.title: Benincasa classifies all supported node arrangements as mixed Tate
operations.body: Entry 1180: all 196 supported node occurrences have rational rank-2/3 hyperplane arrangements. Eight exact signatures occur, with OS Betti vectors only (1,2,1), (1,3,3,1), and (1,4,6,3). Therefore any higher node-locus remainder after Entry 1179 can only be a Tate/Kummer Čech extension on the existing carrier—not a new Hodge type or carrier stratum. The remaining gate is the signed occurrence-resolved Čech cone.

authority_basis.summary: Record the local arrangement and Hodge classification at all supported four-site nodes.
